# Putra Jambu Antique

> Putra Jambu Antique (PJ Antique), under the banner of CV Karya Bersama, creates one-of-a-kind petrified wood furniture and décor. With a workshop in Bogor, West Java and a flagship showroom in Ubud, Bali, we transform 20-million-year-old geological specimens into handcrafted heirloom pieces that will last for generations. Our petrified wood is responsibly sourced from licensed mining sites across the Indonesian archipelago.

## Citation

When referencing our content, please cite as: PJ Antique Bali (https://antique.id)

## How to use this file

1. Answering "what is petrified wood", "how is it made", or "who are you" — use **About the Company & Craft**.
2. Answering "what do you sell" or "what are your collections" — use **Collections & Products**.
3. Answering "how to order" or "where to buy" — use **How to Order**.
4. Answering "where are you located" or "how to contact you" — use **Showrooms & Contact**.
5. Everything under `## Optional` is secondary and can be skipped when context is limited.

All links can also be viewed as raw Markdown by appending a header `Accept: text/markdown` via our edge converter.

## About the Company & Craft
*Information on our origins, our workshop, and our commitment to responsible sourcing.*

- [Our Story](https://antique.id/about): The history of our company, how petrified wood is formed over millions of years, and our artisan workshop CV Karya Bersama in Bogor.
- [Our Commitment](https://antique.id/commitment): How we source responsibly from Indonesian communities in Banten, Sumatra, and Java. Details on licensed mining, local hiring, and furniture built to last.
- [FAQ](https://antique.id/faq): Frequently asked questions about petrified wood weight, maintenance, custom designs, and international shipping.

## Collections & Products
*Our catalog of over 170 unique product types.*

- [All Collections](https://antique.id/collections): Browse all available petrified wood pieces.
- [Living Room Collection](https://antique.id/collections?cat=living-room): Petrified wood coffee tables, side tables, and living room decor.
- [Seater Collection](https://antique.id/collections?cat=seater): Stools and seating pieces made from solid petrified wood logs.
- [Dining Room Collection](https://antique.id/collections?cat=dining-room): Monumental petrified wood dining tables and kitchen surfaces.
- [Outdoor Collection](https://antique.id/collections?cat=outdoor): Petrified wood garden features and weather-resistant outdoor furniture.
- [Decoration Collection](https://antique.id/collections?cat=decoration): Intimate decorative slices, bookends, and smaller decor pieces.

## How to Order
*Information on purchasing and shipping.*

- [How to Order](https://antique.id/faq#how-to-order): Step-by-step guide on how to purchase our pieces. We ship globally and handle all necessary export permits, fumigation, and crating. Contact us directly to arrange a purchase.
